heading: 1727 — Lodge Slave Census
text: 1727 — Lodge Slave Census

The 1727 Lodge Slave Census was transcribed by James Clyde Armstrong; compiler Robert C.H. Shell. Sources: Cape Town Archives, C.344 "Monster rolle van soodanige slaven, bandietten en slavinned." 1727.02.28; Never Previously published.  This is the largerst of the Lodge Census and reflects the reliance of the Company on the slave station Rio del la Goa Bay which was abandoned in 1731.   The cesus is sorted by name of slave, but the sequence number is retained. Click on a letter to view the  names listed. Use the Table of Contents on the left to navigate to the name you wish to view.
